decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf sits right next to the firm's established craft-bakery knowledge, so management can read early sales and refine the recipe.

The historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality and event facilities and its heritage story, so it builds on related knowledge, though it lies somewhat further from the firm's core baking expertise.
The sweet pastry fits squarely within the firm's confectionery tradition and hand-finishing skills, letting it absorb customer feedback and improve the product.
